{{Enemy Echo Tabs}} {{Enemy Infobox |name = Sigillum |title = Homebound Starfarer |image = Sigillum Icon.png |dmgtype = Spectro |weakpoint = Unknown |echo = Yes |class = Calamity |family = |group = |location = [[Gate of the Lost Star]] |drops = Gold in Memory |variants = Tactical Hologram: Sigillum }} {{Description|A wordless black mech, lost and longing to return home.}} {{Lang|Sigillum|zh=辛吉勒姆}} is a [[Calamity Class]] [[Weekly Challenge|Weekly]] [[Boss]] in ''[[Wuthering Waves]]'' that can be found in [[Gate of the Lost Star]]. ==Drops== {{Boss Rewards|weekly=1|exclusive=Gold in Memory}} ==Stats== {{Enemy Stats}} ==Abilities== ==Trophies== {{Trophies|Sigillum|customheader=Sigillum}} ==Description== {{Description|This enemy has a {{Color|help|higher RES}} to {{Color|Spectro DMG}}.
When hit by an Echo Skill, Sigillum gains 1 stack of Off Course, up to 5 stacks. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.
Each stack of Off Course makes it take 10% more total DMG. At 5 stacks, Sigillum takes an additional 30% total DMG.

Rage and tears. Suffering and joy. Sorrow and pain. All are condensed, along with her sigh, into a single golden frequency.
It gazes at the sky, lost in memories worn thin by the ages. The lost voyager is still searching for the way home.|Description When Discovered}} ==Soundtracks== {{Soundtracks by Category Table|type=combat}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Sigillum |zhs = 辛吉勒姆 |zht = 辛吉勒姆 |ja = シギルム |ko = 시길룸 |fr = Sigillum |de = Sigillum |es = Sigillum |th = Sigillum }} ==Trivia== * Sigillum is the entity that siphoned Rover's frequency through the rift in Honami City during [[Flowing Starlight in the Iris]]. ==Change History== {{Change History|3.1}} ==Navigation== {{Enemy Navbox}} [[zh:辛吉勒姆]]
